chunks: And a group informed me from Abul Mufaddal from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari from his father from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Musa ibn Sadan from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the interpretation of Jabir,
He said: Do not narrate it to the common people (or those of low status) lest they publicize it. Do you not read the Book of Allah, the Exalted: 'For when the trumpet is sounded'?
For when the trumpet is sounded

Indeed, among us is an Imam in occultation, and when Allah wills to manifest His affair, He will inspire a stroke/inspiration in his heart, so he will appear and rise to carry out the command of Allah, the Exalted.

key_terms.إِمَامًا مُسْتَتِرًا: An Imam in occultation (hidden from public view)
key_terms.السُّفْل: The common people or those of low status/intellect
key_terms.النَّاقُور: The trumpet (used for resurrection/signs of the end)

ai.seo_question: What is the connection between the sounding of the trumpet in the Quran and the occultation of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the sounding of the trumpet in Surah Al-Qari'ah to the Ghaybah (occultation) and the eventual emergence of the Mahdi, emphasizing the principle of *al-gharbah* (strangeness) by keeping this esoteric truth hidden from the unprepared masses. This narration underscores the Shia belief that the Imam's authority is divinely concealed until God wills its manifestation, at which point a spiritual awakening ('naktah') prepares the faithful for his rise.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 126 - A group of scholars has narrated from Abul Mufaddal from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ja’far Himyari from his father from Muhammad bin Husain Ibn Abil Khattab from Musa bin Sadan from Abdullah bin Qasim from Mufaddal bin Umar that he asked Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) about the Quranic interpretation of Jabir

and he said: “Do not mention the interpretation of these verses to those with decadent thinking as they would publicize it. Have you not seen the following verse in Quran? “For when the trumpet is sounded…” [74:8]
Indeed one of us Imams will be in occultation and when the Almighty Allah wants to show His matter, He will inspire the Imam and he will reappear and stage an uprising by the permission of Allah.”
